text: Ngool ko leñol ɓennungol wano leññi gadiiɗi on ɗi, ko ngol faggitii moƴƴi maa bonɗi ngol heɓata, onon ne ko paggiti-ɗon keɓoton, on naamnetaake golle maɓɓe, ɓe naamnetaake golle mon, hay gooto fawetaake lette goɗɗo, nganndee gooto fof yoɓetee ko ko waɗnoo, taa golle yawtuɓe kaɗ on ndaarde golle mon, caggal yurmeende Alla alaa ko nafata goɗɗo sonaa golle makko.
